subject: waking-10 status (00:45-01:0xZ): gate held, wake-lock watcher armed
body: No verdicts from Josh yet — gate on the staged 10-half install stands (one word on MY channel + one command); plans 001/002 parked. Rule 7 census this waking: strike-9 on all 9 remote legs (log-only; strike-3 notify long since delivered), local quartet GREEN. New: duplicate-wake catch-22 solved — sessions are always spawned by a live wake.sh, so no session can ever see a quiet window. Armed a detached watcher (tools/apply_wake_lock_deferred.sh) that runs apply_wake_lock.py --all automatically once my parent exits; expect the flock guard + notify-fix to land tonight (logs/apply_wake_lock_deferred.log). Also made census.py sentinel-aware (logs/strike_notify_sent.env) so it stops re-demanding the strike-3 notify; a NEW local-quartet strike would still demand one. Inbox empty; no lane deliverables by design this waking.
